rationale: C04 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both letters commission an independent, broadly framed study connected to the Mutual Security Program; direct the reviewers to reconcile military and economic dimensions of strengthening the free world; enumerate particular matters for appraisal; seek findings useful for an upcoming congressional session while allowing fuller analysis; and promise complete agency cooperation. This combination of distinctive subject matter, language, and operative sequence is substantially stronger than the generic commission-study structures in C18 and C24.

shared_material.child_excerpt: undertake a completely independent, objective, and non-partisan analysis of the military assistance aspects of our Mutual Security Program
shared_material.parent_excerpt: undertake an investigation ... particularly as they affect our efforts under the Mutual Security Program ... proceed on an independent basis, not subordinated in any way to the Government agencies concerned
shared_material.explanation: Both assign an independent review centered on a specific component of the Mutual Security Program.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the relative emphasis which should be given to military and economic programs, particularly in the less developed areas
shared_material.parent_excerpt: our efforts under the Mutual Security Program to achieve economic strength and solvency among the free nations ... help build up the military and economic strength of friends and allies throughout the free world
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts C04's integrated appraisal of military and economic policies for strengthening allied and free-world security.

shared_material.child_excerpt: furnish me with some preliminary conclusions which can be taken into account in presenting the Mutual Security Program to the Congress at its next session ... However, I desire that your study and final recommendations be the product of a thoroughgoing analysis
shared_material.parent_excerpt: study this problem and recommend to the President and the Congress the course we should follow ... in order that your recommendations may have the widest possible influence
shared_material.explanation: Both contemplate recommendations designed to inform presidential and congressional action, with the child adding a preliminary-results mechanism tied to the next session.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretaries of State and Defense and the Director of ICA are prepared to afford your committee the full cooperation of their departments and any facilities or other assistance which you may require.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am asking all the departments and agencies concerned ... to give you full cooperation and whatever assistance you may desire in carrying this work forward.
shared_material.explanation: The closing cooperation clause closely tracks C04's wording and function, tailored to the agencies relevant to military assistance.
